title: Feature: Clear Ob1G5StateMachine Queue
symptom: When using G5/G6, commands to be sent to the sensor are stored in a commandQueue that cannot be reset or cleared. For example, a calibration entered in error cannot be removed from the queue, so it will still be sent to the sensor. Similarly, other commands like sensor stop cannot be canceled.
fix: The feature was implemented. To clear the transmitter queue, tap on the treatment menu (syringe symbol), long press on the microphone symbol at the bottom right corner of the keypad, and enter "clear transmitter queue" without the quotes.
evidence_quote: If you need to clear the transmitter queue, tap on the treatment menu (syringe symbol). Long press on the microphone symbol at the bottom right corner of the keypad. Enter "clear transmitter queue" without the quotes.
